The full-year 2023 total was $45.754 billion. Q4 is a derived figure: full-year revenue less the first three quarters, which were $10.98 billion for Q1, $11.97 billion for Q2 and $11.91 billion for Q3. That gives 45.754 − 34.86 = 10.894, or about $10.89 billion. Since the Q4 press release number is $10.85 billion, the quarters I recalled are probably slightly off.

I am going with the reported Q4 figure of $10.85 billion.
